import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a, b, n, i, bx = 0, tx, by = 0, tbi, bbi = 1, eps = 1000000000L;

        a = sc.nextLong();
        b = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            tx = (i * a) / b;

            for (int j = -5; j <= 5; j++) {
                long t = tx + j;
                tbi = b * i;

                long diff = Math.abs(b * t - a * i);
                if (diff * bbi < eps * tbi) {
                    eps = diff;
                    bx = t;
                    by = i;
                    bbi = tbi;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bx + "/" + by);
    }
}
